prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1384; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle moved to the right to change lanes and made contact with the right side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2, which was already in the right lane. Driver 1 stated that the contact was a glancing sideswipe that pushed both vehicles slightly apart. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and was evaluated at the scene. The reported injuries are consistent in type and force with a lateral impact of this kind. A Passenger was also present in Driver 2's vehicle, and Driver 2 reported no injury. Scene photographs show damage to the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the left front fender of Driver 2's vehicle, which are consistent with the account given. No independent witnesses were identified. Some of the damage visible in the photographs may be older or may not be related to this contact, and this has not been resolved. Driver 1's seating position at the moment of impact was not clearly established during the interview. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
